title: The 'Rest alerts' warning stays hidden on OPPO, Xiaomi and similar phones whose own battery rules hold the alert back
what: The warning line checks only Android's own switches: notifications, the rest sound group, Alarms and reminders, and Android's own background limit. Phone makers such as OPPO, Xiaomi and Vivo add their own battery and auto-start rules that can delay or stop 'Rest is over' with the app closed. The app never reads these, so the line stays hidden and the member is never told why the alert came late or never came.
expected: Where a phone maker is known to hold apps back, the warning shows once with a tap that opens that phone's battery or auto-start page, or at least says the alert may be late on this phone.
who: members on OPPO, Xiaomi, Vivo, Realme and similar phones
how_often: every rest with the app closed or the screen off on those phones
fix_line: Read the phone maker's battery setting where possible and show the warning with a link to that phone's battery page

title: The end of a plank countdown never buzzes the watch, though the end of rest does
what: When a timed set's countdown reaches zero the phone gives a buzz and the rest-over sound and saves the set. Nothing is sent to the watch, so a member holding a plank with the phone on the floor and a watch on the wrist feels nothing on the wrist.
expected: The countdown's end reaches the paired watch the same way 'Rest is over' does.
who: members with a paired watch who time planks or holds
fix_line: Send the countdown's end to the watch as a buzz, like the rest alert
